Portfolio

One brand, every day of the week.

Idunnu Homes and Properties needed to post constantly without looking repetitive. I built a flyer system around their logo: a consistent blue and orange palette, a fixed enquiry bar, and a new idea for each occasion, from Monday motivation to weekend family moments to land price drops.

  • Greeting postsNew week, weekend and new month messages that keep the brand in the feed.
  • Offer postsClear price, clear deposit message, clear phone number.
  • VoicePlain English and Pidgin, matched to who is scrolling.

What I design

Property and land ads

Price-led flyers with the details buyers look for: plot size, price, survey and deposit terms, all readable at phone size.

Campaign and greeting posts

A steady run of branded posts for new week, weekend and new month, designed to look like one family.

Service flyers for small businesses

Tailors, hair stylists and shops get a clean list of services, photos of their work and a contact line that is hard to miss.

Event and promo flyers

Tournament announcements, prizes and registration details laid out so people know what to do in three seconds.
